displayIdentity.body: Love stands within speech, knowledge, gifts, and maturity. If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal. But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
displayIdentity.title: Love stands within speech, knowledge, gifts, and maturity
